decisions.reason: The remaining INA3221 monitor-channel count does not change the main-board connector inventory.
The monitor-channel count does not alter the addressable LEDs' supply, switching, or logic-level handling.
Measuring the 5V and 3.3V rails does not change their source OR-ing method or source-selection behavior.
The spare monitoring channel does not change standalone USB-power activation, capacity, or powered scope.
The current-monitor channel allocation has no necessary effect on the local decoupling requirement.
The source decision does not alter any panel control, input, connector, or button behavior.
The source establishes monitor-channel capacity but does not assign or change any ESP32 GPIO.
The monitor-channel count does not change the I2C series-resistor value, placement, or population policy.
Rail current monitoring does not alter the battery-charge status indicator or CHGLED circuitry.
The source does not change the battery connector, pinout, placement, voltage range, or destination.
The INA3221 rail-monitor channel allocation does not affect battery NTC temperature monitoring.
Measuring the 5V rail does not change the boost supply's enable control, GPIO, output, or powered loads.
